title: Atlas and Harbor
author: K. M. Yarrow
blurb: Bram Voss, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
